stages.text: You hear the grinding of wooden wheels and the shuffle of eight hairy legs. You feel the rough texture of wooden bars against your pelt, and a sharp pain in the back of your head.

pages.text: You hear the grinding of wooden wheels and the shuffle of eight hairy legs. You feel the rough texture of wooden bars against your pelt, and a sharp pain in the back of your head.
You are far from home, and moving still. You know this much. And the bindings on your arms and over your eyes infer it was not of your own accord.

stages.text: But "home". Suddenly it seems such a meaningless word. But then again so too does your own name...

pages.text: But "home". Suddenly it seems such a meaningless word. But then again so too does your own name...
You realize now, that you are without your memories, you know not your heading nor the place from whence you came.

stages.text: And yet, you have a strong sense deep within your gut, a piece of knowledge that no tremor to the head can loose:

pages.text: And yet, you have a strong sense deep within your gut, a piece of knowledge that no tremor to the head can loose:
that the greatest things in this world of ours

delayedReveals.text: are those that only the lost may find

stages.text: Suddenly you hear the squeal of the Uumkao'i and a jolt in the wagon, the shouting of its drivers. Then you, your cage and everything around you starts rolling to the side out of the vehicle and down into a rocky descent.

pages.text: Suddenly you hear the squeal of the Uumkao'i and a jolt in the wagon, the shouting of its drivers. Then you, your cage and everything around you starts rolling to the side out of the vehicle and down into a rocky descent.
You can hear your cage snap open as you're lifted through the air.
And after flying free for what feels like minutes, you finally land on the hard ground...

delayedReveals.text: and find yourself asleep once again.
